maximum_permitted_stay: Up to 90 days in any 180-day period; the visa sticker may grant fewer days.
passport_validity_rule: Issued within 10 years; valid at least 3 months after Schengen departure; at least 2 blank pages.
blank_passport_pages_rule: At least two blank pages per the Bangladesh tourist checklist.
return_ticket_rule: Round-trip airline reservation with PNR and itinerary; onward permit if applicable.
proof_of_funds_rule: Finland requires EUR 50/day; Dhaka checklist asks for six-month bank statements and solvency evidence.
accommodation_rule: Hotel confirmation for the whole stay or other proof of accommodation.
travel_insurance_rule: Required for the full Schengen stay; minimum EUR 30,000, valid across all Schengen states.
yellow_fever_or_health_rule: No destination-specific health rule in cited visa guidance; check current health notices.
transit_rule: The Finnish Schengen visa covers Åland; a single-entry visa cannot be used to re-enter Schengen after leaving.
application_channel: Apply in person through VFS Global Dhaka; Sweden represents Finland for Schengen short-stay applications. From 15 October 2026, the Swedish Migration Agency makes decisions on applications submitted in Bangladesh; VFS continues to receive applications and biometrics.
application_fee: EUR 90 (BDT 12,870 adult); VFS BDT 1,573 plus BDT 230 payment fee; subject to change.
processing_time: Normally 15 calendar days; may extend to 45; allow extra time for appointment and submission.

review_notes: Finland Abroad's Bangladesh-specific page confirms that an ordinary Bangladesh passport requires a Schengen visa. Åland follows Finland's Schengen arrangements under the official Åland declaration. Sweden represents Finland for short-stay visa applications in Bangladesh; from 15 October 2026 the Swedish Migration Agency, not the Embassy of Sweden in Dhaka, makes decisions on applications submitted in Bangladesh. VFS Dhaka continues to accept applications and biometrics. The Bangladesh tourist checklist requires one printed 35 x 45 mm colour photo, light background and age under six months; VFS's optional photo-booth service does not replace that printed-photo requirement. The current adult fee is EUR 90 (BDT 12,870); VFS service charge BDT 1,573 and payment processing fee BDT 230 are additional and subject to change. Processing normally takes 15 calendar days and may extend to 45. Finnish MFA guidance states EUR 50 per day for living costs. The record concerns tourism to Åland, not a separate visa class.
notes: Åland is an autonomous region of Finland and follows Finland/Schengen short-stay entry rules; no separate Åland visa is issued. Finland is represented by Sweden in Bangladesh. Since 15 October 2026, the Swedish Migration Agency decides short-stay applications submitted in Bangladesh; VFS Dhaka continues to receive applications and biometrics. Government visa fee and VFS charges are distinct and subject to change.

blank_passport_pages_rule: At least two blank pages per France-Visas Bangladesh guidance.

transit_rule: A French-issued Schengen visa is valid for Monaco; multiple entry is needed if leaving and re-entering Schengen.
application_channel: Apply online through France-Visas, book and submit in person at VFS Global Dhaka. The Embassy of France in Dhaka examines applications; when Monaco is the main destination, the French consulate issues a Schengen visa valid for Monaco and the Schengen area.
application_fee: EUR 90 Schengen fee; BDT equivalent at consular rate; VFS service fee additional.
processing_time: Normally 15 calendar days; may extend to 45; appointment waiting time varies.

review_notes: France-Visas' Monaco FAQ states that a valid Schengen visa permits entry to Monaco and that Schengen residence-permit holders may enter without a short-stay visa. Where a short-stay visa is required and Monaco is the main destination, the French consulate issues a Schengen visa valid for Monaco and the Schengen area. EU Regulation 2018/1806 Annex I lists Bangladesh as visa-required for Schengen short stays. France-Visas Bangladesh directs applicants to apply online and submit in person through VFS Dhaka; the French Embassy in Dhaka decides. Long-stay cases are separate and referred to the Monegasque authorities.
notes: A Bangladesh ordinary passport holder needs a short-stay Schengen visa when no qualifying exemption applies. A valid Schengen visa permits entry to Monaco; a residence permit issued by a Schengen State also permits visa-free entry. If Monaco is the main destination, the French consulate issues a Schengen visa valid for Monaco and the Schengen area. Long-stay applications follow a separate procedure involving the Monegasque authorities.
